treaty_name: Convention between the Government of the Kingdom of Norway and the Government of the Republic of Kazakhstan for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income and on capital (2001)
eif_quote: Lovdata metadata: "Avtalens ikrafttredelsesdato 24-01-2006" | Art. 30(2): "The Convention shall enter into force on the date of receipt of the later of these notifications and shall thereupon have effect: a. in respect of taxes withheld at source on dividends, interest or royalties, for amounts paid or credited on or after the first day of the second month following the month in which the Convention enters into force;"
source_title: Lovdata Norges traktater (English version), Convention Norway-Kazakhstan 2001 (Norwegian, Kazakh, Russian, English equally authentic)

rates.quote: a. 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company which holds directly at least 10 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends;
b. 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.

However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State, but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the interest the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.

However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State, but if the recipient and the beneficial owner of the royalties is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.basis: none (MLI not applicable: Norway does not list Kazakhstan); treaty has only article-specific main-purpose rules in Arts. 11(8) and 12(9)
ppt.quote: 8. The provisions of this Article shall not apply if it was the main purpose or one of the main purposes of any person concerned with the creation or assignment of the debt-claim in respect of which the interest is paid to take advantage of this Article by means of that creation or assignment.

notes: Not MLI-covered (Kazakhstan lists Norway, Norway does not list Kazakhstan), so no PPT and no Art. 8 holding period. Art. 11(4): interest exempt at source on government/regional/local bonds, and on loans/credits made, guaranteed or insured by the Central Bank of Norway, GIEK, Eksportfinans (Kazakh-source) or the National Bank of Kazakhstan/Eximbank (Norwegian-source) - not modelled. Art. 12(3): leasing royalties may at the owner's election be taxed on a net basis as PE income. Art. 12(8): automatic MFN - if Kazakhstan later agrees with a then-OECD member a narrower royalty definition, exemption or lower rate, it applies automatically; no official Norwegian notice of a triggered reduction was located, so 10% is recorded. Art. 10(6): branch profits tax up to 5% (not modelled). WHT effect from the first day of the second month after entry into force (2006-03-01).
unverified: Whether the Art. 12(8) royalty MFN clause has been triggered by a later Kazakhstan treaty with an OECD member
